ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Ice
ModMetaData.author: CheaterEater
ModMetaData.description:
Harvest ice from frozen lakes and use ice blocks to cool your base.
Pawns can designate Ice Harvest Zones over thin ice or thick ice sheets. Harvesting yields ice blocks which absorb heat as they melt, cooling the room they are stored in — a low-tech alternative to electric coolers.
Requires the Odyssey DLC for thin-ice harvesting. Thick ice (vanilla) is always available. The mod loads safely without Odyssey.
Configure cooling power and harvest yield in Mod Settings.
